title: Repeat
draftHint: Once the event is published, you can have it open again by itself every week or every two weeks.
body: This event opens again by itself on the same day and time, with the same details, every week or every two weeks. New events open two weeks ahead, and players join each one separately.
quota: You can have at most 2 repeating events at a time. Stop one to start another.
activeBody: New events open by themselves two weeks ahead. Changing or canceling one event does not change the series.
apply: Make the next events like this one
applyHint: This event's details, day, time and registration close apply to the events not opened yet. Events already opened stay as they are.
appliedToast: The next events will open like this one
next: Next: {{date}}. It opens two weeks before.
confirmStop: Once the series stops, no new events open. Events already opened stay as they are; you can cancel them one by one.

stopped.BY_ORGANIZER: You stopped this series; no new events open.
stopped.ORGANIZER_UNAVAILABLE: The series stopped because your account cannot organize events right now.
stopped.DETAILS_INVALID: The series stopped because some of its saved details are no longer valid (for example, the format was retired or the district closed).
stopped.NO_PLAYERS: The series stopped because nobody besides you joined 3 events in a row.
